validation.sourcePhaseNote: The optimized full regression preceded final test-only assertions and fixed-array chunk iteration; final optimized topography tests and strict Clippy include them. Physical/reference arithmetic is unchanged across those phases. The full npm suite additionally exercises all native targets and Node tests.

limitations: Exact dyadic equilibrium does not imply bit-exact rest on arbitrary rounded stocks/bed; the non-dyadic case retains positive roundoff flow and altered low components.
The separate low-order head baseline does not repair or replace flat-pressure extrema/plateau refusals.
One-head local hydrostatic equilibration cannot resolve moving intracell head variation or disconnected pools behind an unrepresented internal ridge.
Dry minimum-bed ordering is a numerical surrogate, not an inferred physical water level; endpoint crests differ from paper center-bed geometry.
The two-owner ODE is discrete temporal validation, not variable-bed PDE accuracy, spatial order or a general positivity/stability theorem.
No new production, spherical, seasonal, persistence, protocol or desktop selection. Frozen overtopping direction is not calibrated discharge.
